fields.description: International mid-market M&A and debt advisory firm (offices across the US, Europe and Asia, incl. a listed London office) advising private equity and owner-managed businesses.
fields.notes: LIVINGSTONE PARTNERS LIMITED (06720751) has been in creditors' voluntary liquidation since July 2022 (resolution 27 Jul 2022, liquidator's statements to 2026). Site (checked 2026-10-08) still lists a London office at 81-83 Fulham High Street, SW6 3JW, but the full team page shows no London-based professionals (partners in Chicago, LA, Düsseldorf, Amsterdam, Madrid, Milan, Paris, Stockholm, Seoul). UK deal team size unverified.

reason: The firm is active internationally and its site still lists a London office, so it is not closed; but its UK company went into liquidation in 2022 and the team page lists nobody in London, so the 'headquartered in London' description is unsupported. UK presence should be treated as unverified.

fields.notes: Old company SOVEREIGN BUSINESS TRANSFER LIMITED (06652960) entered creditors' voluntary liquidation on 2 July 2026. The business still trades as Sovereign Business Transfer through SOVEREIGN BUSINESS BROKERS LIMITED (17208073, incorporated 8 May 2026, same director Matthew Trinder), named in the site footer (Cheadle Place, Stockport Road, Cheadle SK8 2JX).

reason: The site is live with listings, and its footer names a new company (17208073) with the same director as the company in liquidation. The brokerage moved to a new company and still trades.

Founder and sole director Chris Silverwood died suddenly (BusinessCloud, 3 Jul 2026). CORPFIN LIMITED (11110930), the company named on the site, filed dormant accounts for 2024, has overdue filings, and has a compulsory strike-off gazetted Sep 2026. The site has not been updated since 2023 (copyright 2023), and no acquirer or successor was found.

fields.notes: IBA CORPORATE LIMITED (11659120) never filed accounts and applied for voluntary strike-off in 2023 (suspended). The group trades through sister companies at the same Leamington Spa address, e.g. IBA CORPORATE BROKERS LIMITED (12753346, active, accounts to Jul 2025, confirmation statement Jul 2026).

reason: The company being struck off is a dormant group shell. The site is live (copyright 2026), and sister company IBA Corporate Brokers Ltd at the same address is active with current filings.

fields.notes: Trading entity is Vexus Corporate Limited (08143277, formerly Vexus Business Brokers Ltd, Woking), active. VEXUS LTD (12271762, Manchester) with a strike-off proposal is an unrelated namesake.

reason: Namesake: the site names Vexus Corporate Limited (08143277, Woking, active, accounts to Jun 2025). The company in trouble is a separate Manchester company.

Namesake: KROLL LTD (08776921) is a former construction company (formerly Kroll Construction Ltd) in Romford, unrelated to Kroll's UK advisory business, which runs through other active Kroll companies (e.g. Kroll Advisory Ltd 05568550).

Namesake: the site says Qiao is a trading name of Qiao Capital Advisors Ltd (13448601), which is active with accounts to Jun 2025 and a confirmation statement from Dec 2025. QIAO LTD (14728870) is unrelated.

The rename is an internal restructure: the old LLP (now TAARR LLP, dissolved 2024) was replaced by MITCHELL CHARLESWORTH (SERVICES) LIMITED (01491356), which is active and owned since 2022 by MC Topco Limited (13862059), alongside Mitchell Charlesworth (Audit) Ltd. The practice still trades, though its site sits behind a captcha.

fields.notes: UK firm's own site is https://translinkcf.uk (Translink CF (BHP) LLP and I.M.A Corporate Finance Limited). TRANSLINK CORPORATE FINANCE LIMITED (16855721, Sheffield, inc. Nov 2025) was renamed TRANSLINK CORPORATE FINANCE (SUMER BHP) LIMITED on 31 Dec 2025, when BHP Professional Services Limited replaced BHP LLP as its PSC. This is a BHP group restructure, not a closure. The UK page still lists 9 partners/directors in Sheffield, Leeds, Leicester and London.

reason: The renamed company is a new (Nov 2025) BHP group entity reorganised within BHP. The Translink UK team page and translinkcf.uk are live with the same 9 professionals and 4 offices. Consider switching the website to https://translinkcf.uk, the UK firm's own domain.

fields.notes: Company: TRILLIUM PARTNERS LIMITED (07011410, formerly Trillium Corporate Finance Limited, London SW13), active with micro accounts to Jun 2025 and a confirmation statement in Sep 2026. Directors include Philip Mastriforte and Stephen Routledge. The site footer still says '© 2020 Trillium Finance Limited'.

reason: The firm's own company was renamed, not closed: it is active with current filings, and the site is live and still offers partner-led CF advice.

fields.notes: WESTCOTTS HOLDINGS LIMITED (12267770), the former parent of the Westcotts Financial Management wealth arm, came under Advanta Solutions Ltd control on 25 Nov 2025 and was renamed ADVANTA WEALTH (SOUTH WEST) HOLDINGS LTD. The accountancy practice (Westcotts (SW) LLP; Westcotts Audit LLP inc. Oct 2025) still trades, and its corporate finance page is live with no mention of Advanta.

reason: Only the wealth-management holding company was acquired and renamed. The accountancy firm still trades as Westcotts (SW) LLP, and its CF page is live.
